title: 第15章 血战鼍龙第16章 再拼
content_zh:
已经有许多尸体横七竖八地躺在泥水里，还有更多受伤的人在往后爬，哀嚎声混着雨声传来。
能驱策这些的，只有那些强横的妖物。
昨夜之言，竟一语成谶！
这是不逊于三十年前的水灾！必须穷尽整个长溪部族精锐之力，才能挡住！
“列阵！”祁云暴喝。
甲士们迅速展开战阵，持盾在前，长戈在后，血气勾连成网，步步前行，压向岸边。
而三名地境武士几乎同时冲了出去。
祁云居中，血煞涌出体表，一剑劈开一条缠住伤兵的巨蟒。
祁虎在左翼，一锤砸爆了一只蟾蜍精的脑袋，“嘭”的一声，黏液溅了他一脸。
“呸！臭得要命！”
祁澜在右翼，铜剑横扫，血煞附刃，将一条试图窜向伤员的异化鳝鱼斩成两段。
甲士的军阵也压了上来，长戈如林，配合地境武士的突击，将冲上岸的小型精怪成片地戳翻在地。
这些精怪虽然数量多，但绝大部分也就是人境武士的水平，在有组织的军阵面前讨不到便宜。“杀！”
“把它们赶回水里去！”
战况在朝着好的方向发展——
然后祁澜的后颈猛地一凉。
这种感觉没有来由，但他还是顺从本能做出了反应。
脚下踏川步骤然变向，整个人横移出去三步。
“轰！”
一声巨响，他原先立足之处，泥水轰然炸开！一张布满惨白獠牙的血盆大口破水而出，带着万钧之势，狠狠咬在空处！那恐怖的咬合力，竟将岸边的泥沙碎石碾得粉碎，发出令人牙酸的“咯吱”声。

祁澜回头一看，瞳孔骤缩。
那是一条鳄。
不，那东西已经不能叫鳄了。
体长足有三丈以上，鳞甲漆黑如铁，背脊高耸，腹部厚实，比寻常的鳄鱼足足大了一倍有余。
最显眼的是它的脑袋——两眼之间，鼻后上方，鼓起了一对对称的青黑色软包，隐隐有灵光流转。
这玩意，便是人们口中的鼍龙，有化蛟的潜力。
其实力，已经相当于地境武者，和三十年前造成前任长溪子爵阵亡的那条蛟蟒一样，已经一只脚迈进了化蛟的道路之上。
“少君小心！后面还有！”
熟悉地的吼声从身后传来。
是默老头。
人境后期的他，是邦国上士，也在这三百人境武士当中。
祁澜猛地扭头，只见那只鼍龙的身后，十余条体型一两丈出头的普通鼍鳄接连翻出水面，沿着堤坝的缺口，如暗箭般射向岸上。
鳄群！
从水中猛扑上岸，咬住猎物后死亡翻滚，这本就是鳄鱼最擅长的捕猎方式。
这些鳄虽然还没成长到堪比地境的地步，但体型凶悍，牙齿锋利，一时间，愣是突袭杀伤了几名甲士，将其拖下去。
祁澜侧身一脚直踹，将一条两丈长的鳄鱼踹下水，随后飞身而上，一剑将边上的鳄鱼斩首，将被拖下水的一名甲士拉了上来。
“甲士先拦小的！地境的两条鼍龙交给我们！”
祁云的声音从另一侧传来，但听上去有些紧绷。
content_en:
There were already many corpses lying in the mud and water, and more injured people were crawling back. The sound of wailing mixed with the sound of rain.
The only ones who can drive this are those tyrannical monsters.
What I said last night turned out to be a prophecy!
This is no worse than the floods thirty years ago! Only the entire Changxi tribe’s elite power can be used to stop it!
"Array up!" Qi Yun shouted.
The soldiers quickly formed a battle formation, holding their shields in front and their spears at the back. They formed a web of blood and energy, moving forward step by step, pressing towards the shore.
The three Earth Warriors rushed out almost at the same time.
Qi Yun was in the middle, blood gushed out of his body, and he slashed open a giant python wrapped around the wounded soldier with one sword.
Qi Hu was on the left wing and smashed the head of a toad spirit with a hammer. There was a "bang" sound and mucus splashed all over his face.
"Bah! It stinks like hell!"
Qi Lan was on the right wing, sweeping his bronze sword with a bloody blade attached, cutting an alienated eel into two pieces as it tried to rush toward the wounded.
The military formation of the soldiers also pressed forward, with their long arms like a forest, and cooperated with the assault of the warriors on the ground, knocking over the small monsters that washed ashore in pieces.
Although there are many of these spirits, most of them are at the level of human warriors and cannot get any advantage in the face of an organized military formation. "Kill!"
"Drive them back into the water!"
The war situation is developing in a good direction——
Then Qi Lan felt a sudden chill on the back of his neck.
There was no reason for this feeling, but he still followed his instinct and reacted.
The steps he stepped onto the river suddenly changed direction, and he moved three steps laterally.
"Boom!"
There was a loud noise, and the muddy water exploded where he originally stood! A bloody mouth covered with pale fangs burst out of the water, biting into the empty space with a powerful force! The terrifying bite force actually crushed the sand and gravel on the shore to pieces, making a tooth-wrenching "crunching" sound.
Qi Lan looked back and his pupils shrank suddenly.
That's a crocodile.
No, that thing can no longer be called a crocodile.
The body is more than three feet long, the scales are as black as iron, the back is high, and the abdomen is thick. It is more than twice the size of an ordinary crocodile.
The most conspicuous thing is its head - between the eyes and above the nose, there is a pair of symmetrical green-black soft bumps, with a faint aura flowing.
This thing is what people call a dragon, and it has the potential to transform into a dragon.
His strength is already equivalent to that of an Earth Realm warrior. Like the python that caused the death of his predecessor, Viscount Changxi thirty years ago, he has already taken one foot on the road to transforming into a dragon.
"Young Master, be careful! There are others behind you!"
A familiar roar came from behind.
It's old man Mo.
In the late Human Realm, he was a sergeant in the country and among the three hundred Human Realm warriors.
Qi Lan turned his head sharply and saw that behind the crocodile, more than a dozen ordinary crocodiles over one or two feet tall came out of the water one after another and shot towards the shore like hidden arrows along the gap in the dam.
Crocodiles!
Swooping out of the water onto the shore, biting the prey and then rolling over to death, this is the crocodile's best hunting method.
Although these crocodiles have not grown to a level comparable to the terrain, they are fierce in size and have sharp teeth. For a while, they suddenly killed several soldiers in a surprise attack and dragged them down.
Qi Lan turned sideways and kicked a two-foot-long crocodile into the water. Then he flew up and beheaded the crocodile next to him with a sword, and pulled up a soldier who was dragged into the water.
"Soldier, stop the little one first! Leave the two dragons in the realm to us!"
Qi Yun's voice came from the other side, but it sounded a little tight.
